claim: La Dimora at Da Vittorio is a 10-room Relais & Châteaux property on the restaurant estate; Junior Suite €700, Double €650, closed ~20 days in August.
quote: Junior Suite: €700 (€600 for single use); Double Room: €650 (€550 for single use). Approximately 10 minutes by car from Bergamo, the property occupies ten hectares of countryside featuring tennis courts, a football pitch, and two natural lakes.

claim: Da Vittorio is a Relais & Châteaux hotel/restaurant property in Brusaporto.
quote: Da Vittorio – Luxury hotel Brusaporto – Relais & Châteaux.

claim: Da Vittorio holds three Michelin stars in the 2026 Italia guide and sits in Brusaporto.
quote: Da Vittorio – Brusaporto – Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey. 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italia.

claim: Brusaporto to Bergamo by taxi: 8.9 km, ~11 minutes, €16–20 daytime fare.
quote: Taxi: Distance 8.9 km; Time 11 min; Cost €16–20.

claim: Bergamo taxi night tariff (21:00–06:00): €7.60 base + €1.28 per km.
quote: From 21:00 to 06:00, the base fare is €7.60 and the rate per kilometre is €1.28.

claim: GombitHotel occupies a 13th-century medieval tower complex in Bergamo Città Alta with 12 rooms + 3 suites by designer Giò Pozzi.
quote: GombitHotel features 12 rooms and 3 suites outfitted by designer Giò Pozzi… accentuating 13th-century architecture with carefully selected art pieces.

claim: GombitHotel is a Design Hotels member next to the Gombito Tower in the historic centre.
quote: GombitHotel is set in Bergamo center, a 2-minute walk from Santa Maria Maggiore Cathedral, next to the Gombito Tower… member of Design Hotels.

claim: GombitHotel published rates start around $210/night, average ~$430.
quote: The average price for a night at Gombithotel is $432 and can go as low as $210/night.

claim: Hotel Piazza Vecchia is a 14th-century townhouse on Bergamo Città Alta's main street with 13 rooms across three floors.
quote: 13 elegant rooms, located on 3 floors of the fourteenth-century palace… exposed beams original from the 1300, wooden floors, precious textiles.

claim: Hotel Piazza Vecchia rooms start from €203/night.
Relais San Lorenzo is a 5-star, 30-room luxury hotel in Bergamo Alta built over Roman archaeological remains visible through crystal floors.
quote: Luxury Boutique Hotel… built on an area that preserves precious Roman archaeological remains visible through crystal floors. 30 rooms furnished with designer furniture.

claim: Relais San Lorenzo standard room rates approximately $294–$678; suites $485–$866.
quote: Standard rooms range from $294-$678 (USD), and suites range from $485-$866 (USD).

claim: Relais San Vigilio al Castello is a 9-room boutique hotel in restored 1630 castle barracks atop San Vigilio hill above Bergamo Alta.
quote: Small and elegant nine-room Boutique Hotel located in the highest part of the city of Bergamo, San Vigilio hill. The buildings date back to 1630 and were originally the soldiers' quarters of the adjoining castle.

claim: Relais San Vigilio is set among gardens on the highest point of Bergamo with views of the Upper Town and plain.
quote: Relais San Vigilio al Castello – on San Vigilio hill, with splendid views of the old city and the boundless plain below.

claim: Palazzo Rivola is a 17th-century B&B in Città Alta with garden and on-site parking, walking distance from Piazza Vecchia.
quote: Beautiful property built in the 17th century with a lovely garden… very conveniently situated in Citta Alta… parking inside the structure.

claim: Villa Redona is a 16th-century wine estate agriturismo in Trescore Balneario with 10 rooms across the historic Medolago Albani property.
quote: Villa Redona has 10 comfortable and modern rooms… part of this wine-growing estate since the end of the 16th century… 23 hectares of vineyards.

claim: Villa Redona rates: standard double €155, superior €185, suite €200.
quote: Suites at €200/night, standard double rooms at €155/night, and superior double rooms at €185/night.

claim: Petronilla is a boutique hotel in Bergamo's lower town (Città Bassa) with each room individually decorated around modern art.
quote: Petronilla – Boutique Hotel… in the heart of Bergamo's lower city, in the historic San Lazzaro area, with each room being unique and featuring modern art.
